title: SpikingGamma: Temporally Precise Online SNN Training Through Smoothed Temporal Delays
abstract: arXiv:2602.01978v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Neuromorphic hardware implementations of Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient, low-latency AI through sparse, event-driven computation. Yet, training SNNs under fine temporal discretization remains challenging, hindering low-latency responsiveness and the mapping of software-trained SNNs to efficient hardware. In current approaches, spiking neurons are modeled as self-recurrent units, embedded into recurrent networks to maintain state over time, and trained with BPTT or RTRL variants based on surrogate gradients. These methods scale poorly with temporal resolution, while online approximations exhibit instability for long sequences and tend to fail at capturing temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we develop SpikingGamma, an SNN architecture in which neurons maintain a compact bank of smoothed-delay states and communicate through sigma-delta spike-coding. translated_title: SpikingGamma：通过平滑时间延迟实现时间精确的在线脉冲神经网络训练
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）的神经形态硬件实现通过稀疏的、事件驱动的计算，有望实现节能、低延迟的人工智能。然而，在精细时间离散化下训练SNN仍然具有挑战性，这阻碍了低延迟响应能力以及将软件训练的SNN映射到高效硬件上。在当前的方法中，脉冲神经元被建模为自循环单元，嵌入循环网络中以随时间维持状态，并使用基于代理梯度的BPTT或RTRL变体进行训练。这些方法在时间分辨率提高时扩展性较差，而在线近似方法在长序列上表现出不稳定性，且往往无法捕捉时间模式。为了解决这些局限性，我们开发了SpikingGamma，这是一种SNN架构，其中神经元维护一个紧凑的平滑延迟状态库，并通过sigma-delta脉冲编码进行通信。我们证明在前馈网络中，SpikingGamma能够实现……
tldr: SpikingGamma是一种新型SNN架构，神经元通过维护紧凑的平滑延迟状态库并以sigma-delta脉冲编码进行通信，实现了时间精确的在线训练，克服了传统基于代理梯度的方法在精细时间分辨率下扩展性差、在线近似不稳定且难以捕捉时间模式的局限。
en_tdlr: SpikingGamma is a novel SNN architecture in which neurons maintain compact banks of smoothed-delay states and communicate via sigma-delta spike-coding, enabling temporally precise online training that overcomes the poor temporal scaling, instability, and pattern-capture failures of conventional surrogate-gradient-based approaches.
